## Make it yours

1. Rename the package and the `name` export in `src/index.ts`.
2. Replace the note domain with yours

— keep the Config/tool/card/hook shapes.
3. Rebuild the `cordis.yml` `name:` file URL to point at y

tool/card/hook shapes.
3. Rebuild the `cordis.yml` `name:` file URL to point at your `src/index.ts`.
## Publish to the ecosystem

This project is already a **bundle** (`dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json`), the
official distributi
on format: install it into any profile with `dsh plugin add`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

> Windows note: `dsh plugin add` forwards the path to pnpm, which splits on
> spaces — keep the pack
age on a path without spaces, or use a tarball.
To share it with the community:

1. Push this project to your own GitHub repository.
2. Add the `dsh-plugin` topic to your repo
so th

e community can discover it.
3. Users can then install straight from GitHub (`dsh plugin --profile m

y-profile
add github:you/dsh-plugin-scaffold`). The `prepare` script builds `lib/` from
source on in

stall — pnpm will ask you to allowlist the build once
(see the package-and-install tutorial).
4. (Op
tional) `npm publish` to make it installable by name.
